thermae, thermārum f. pl.

noun, first declension, plural

hot baths, a large bathing establishment

A modern spa is naturally thermae or balneae.

Examples

  • Hodiē in thermās īmus.

    We’re going to the spa today.composed

Other words

  • balneae, balneārum f. — public baths, a bath complex

    noun, first declension · also used · classical

  • aquae, aquārum f. — mineral springs, a spa town

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Planc. 65; L&S

    ad aquās venīre, go to the spa (Cic. Planc. 65; L&S); hence Aquae Sextiae (Aix) and Aquae Mattiacae (Wiesbaden).

See also public baths, sauna, hot tub, changing room.

SourcesLewis & Short: thermae · Lewis & Short: balneum · Lewis & Short: aqua
